title: Introducing AI Predictability 2.0 – Engineering Intelligence, Reimagined
summary: Waydev - Introducing AI Predictability 2.0 – Engineering Intelligence, Reimagined
body_markdown:
## Key Takeaways


- The redesigned AI Predictability model improves accuracy and transparency, allowing for better understanding of engineering performance.
- Users can generate insights, see predictions, and receive personalized recommendations with the new AI features.
- Groups now replace Projects as the default view, offering more flexibility for organizing work.
- Persistent team filters and dynamic project redefinitions enhance usability across the platform.
- Waydev integrates new GitHub Copilot metrics and develops a Waydev MCP for insights in compatible tools.


Estimated reading time:


2


minutes


#### We’ve redesigned **AI Predictability** from the ground up. The new model brings higher accuracy, greater transparency, and a better understanding of how your engineering performance evolves in real time.


With this update, you can:


- Choose any **insight or graph** in the platform
- Click the **AI button**
- See predictions for **Expected vs. Actual AVG**
- Review personalized **recommendations** to reach the expected target
- Deploy a **Target Agent** to track progress automatically


### A More Flexible Way to Organize Work


We’re also rethinking how organizations structure data inside Waydev.
From now on, **Groups** replace Projects as the default view. When creating a Group, you can define it as an **Initiative** , **Workspace** , or **Project** — depending on how your teams operate.


This shift lets you align Waydev with the way your organization actually works, whether you’re managing cross-functional initiatives or large-scale workspaces. You can even edit an existing Project and redefine it as a Group, Initiative, or Workspace at any time.


### A Few More Upgrades


- **Team filters** now stay persistent across pages
- **Projects** can be redefined dynamically into different group types
- We’re integrating **GitHub Copilot’s new metrics** from GitHub Universe into the Waydev AI Adoption module
- A new **Waydev MCP** is in development to deliver insights directly inside **Claude** , **Cursor** , and other MCP-compatible tools
